title: Grateful Dead Live at Monterey Performing Arts Center on 1969-06-14
lineage: Dat > Tascam DA-40 > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/48
taper: Recorded by Bear DAT source from Joel Pollack
source: SBD > Bear’s master cassette (Ampex C90) > Dick’s cassette (TDK-SA-X100) > DAT 16bit/48kHz

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a wild, exploratory 1969 set with fiery Eleven and off‑kilter Lovelight moments despite an uneven Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording (a soundboard source) delivers a clear enough picture of a short, psychedelic blues‑heavy show that feels very much in the 1969 Dead spirit. Reviewers highlight Jerry’s excited, fast playing on The Eleven and Pigpen’s slurred second Lovelight as memorable quirks, while noting Dark Star is only marginally above average for the year. Overall the performance is deemed classic ’69 material, though the show’s flow feels a bit uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer gives a low rating (0) focusing on overall vibe, while another rates it 4 stars and praises specific performances; with limited data the average leans toward a solid but not exceptional show.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit complaints about sound; reviewers thank the engineer (Miller) and imply a decent capture, though details on clarity or mix are absent.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short, psychedelic‑blues driven set typical of 1969; energetic peaks with The Eleven and quirky moments in Lovelight, but the Dark Star/Stephen/Eleven suite is described as unexceptional.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Excited, fast playing on The Eleven; generally high energy throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s second Lovelight sung a half‑step low, sounding drunk but amusing and not bad.
